readerCopy.body: One announcement turns a local idea into a much larger promise. A publication, legal decision, course, campaign, or travel plan reaches more people at the exact moment its language becomes difficult to revise. Mercury gives the idea a message and distribution route, while Jupiter amplifies its reach, confidence, and claim to importance. Under the conjunction, the words and the expansion happen together. The opportunity may be real, but every overstatement now grows with the audience that repeats it.
